stories.title: Dow, S&P 500 climb as Trump says Hormuz deal is close; Nasdaq gives back gains
stories.summary: The Dow and S&P 500 advanced after President Trump said a deal over the Strait of Hormuz was close, easing some geopolitical concern. The Nasdaq initially rose alongside the other indexes but gave up its gains during the session, per Yahoo Finance.
stories.whyItMatters: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical oil-shipping chokepoint, so any easing of tension there ripples through energy prices and broader risk sentiment.
whatToWatch: Further details or confirmation of the reported Hormuz deal
Whether the Nasdaq recovers or extends today's underperformance
questions: What exactly is the Hormuz deal Trump referenced?
Why did the Nasdaq lag the Dow and S&P 500 despite the same headline?

stories.title: Uber shares drop 7% on weak guidance despite revenue growth
stories.summary: Uber stock fell about 7% after the company issued guidance that disappointed investors, even though revenue continued to grow, according to CNBC. The reaction suggests markets are weighting the forward outlook more heavily than the recent top-line results.
stories.whyItMatters: Uber is a bellwether for consumer spending on ride-hailing and delivery, so soft guidance can flag broader caution about demand or margins ahead.
whatToWatch: Management commentary explaining the guidance shortfall
Analyst price target changes following the report
questions: What specifically in the guidance disappointed investors?
Was the miss concentrated in a particular segment, like delivery or freight?

stories.title: Citadel posts best month in years on 'Situational Awareness' stock bets
stories.summary: Ken Griffin's Citadel notched its best month in years after buying into so-called Situational Awareness stocks, CNBC reports. The report ties the fund's standout performance directly to that positioning, though it doesn't specify which stocks fall under the theme.
stories.whyItMatters: Citadel is one of the most closely watched multistrategy funds, so a standout month tied to a specific thematic bet signals where sophisticated capital is rotating.
whatToWatch: Whether Citadel discloses more detail on the trade in future filings
Whether other large funds follow into the same theme

stories.title: AMD stock sinks after earnings as Lisa Su brushes off Musk's Nvidia commitment
stories.summary: AMD shares fell following its latest earnings report, and CEO Lisa Su downplayed comments from Elon Musk about a commitment to Nvidia chips, according to CNBC. The stock decline came alongside the earnings release rather than being solely tied to the Musk remarks.
stories.whyItMatters: AMD is Nvidia's chief rival in AI chips, so any signal that major buyers favor Nvidia feeds directly into the competitive narrative investors are pricing into both stocks.
whatToWatch: Full details of AMD's earnings results and forward guidance
Any follow-up comments from Musk or his companies on chip supplier plans
questions: What exactly did Musk commit to regarding Nvidia?
Did AMD's earnings themselves miss expectations, or is the stock reacting mainly to the Musk comments?

stories.title: Saudi wealth fund and Kushner's Affinity finalize $55 billion EA Sports deal
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners have finalized a $55 billion deal involving EA Sports (Electronic Arts), CNBC reports. It's one of the largest gaming-related transactions involving the Saudi wealth fund to date.
stories.whyItMatters: A deal of this size underscores how deeply sovereign wealth capital is now embedded in major U.S. gaming franchises, with implications for EA's ownership and strategy.
whatToWatch: Regulatory review or disclosures tied to the deal's close

questions: What stake or assets specifically change hands in the deal?

stories.title: Google's AI leadership reshuffle: Jeff Dean exits, Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO
stories.summary: Google is undergoing a shakeup atop its AI organization: chief scientist Jeff Dean is departing and Demis Hassabis is stepping down as CEO of DeepMind, according to CNBC. The moves mark a significant change in leadership of the company's AI research efforts.
stories.whyItMatters: Google's AI leadership has been central to its competitive standing against OpenAI and other rivals, so departures at this level raise questions about strategy and continuity.

stories.title: Trump administration refunds $100 billion in 'liberation day' tariffs
stories.summary: The Trump administration has refunded $100 billion collected under its 'liberation day' tariff program, according to CNBC. The scale of the refund marks a significant reversal of revenue previously collected under the policy.
stories.whyItMatters: A refund of this size affects federal revenue projections and signals a shift in tariff policy that could change cost structures for importers and trade-exposed companies.
whatToWatch: Which companies or sectors receive the refunds
